what.text: This page follows refugees from Burundi living in Zambia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11682 Burundian refugees in Zambia, 3.7% of all refugees from Burundi.
Tanzania hosts the most Burundian refugees, followed by Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in many years from 1991, at war level in some of them.
In its most recent periods the opponents it records include RED-TABARA and FPB from 2014 to 2015, and RED-TABARA and FNL-Ubugabo-Burihabwa from 2019 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 260 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Zambia.
These are year-end totals for Zambia only, reported to UNHCR.
